items.note: Teal band header with pill category tabs above a 4-column grid of outlined cards with band-colour image wells and pink price tags. No card shows the -4px lift or the hard shadow, so the hovered state looks exactly like the rest state.

Dark grid of #222 raised cards on a black ground under the teal band, with an ink-filled selected 'All' pill. As in light mode, no card is lifted and none carries the 35% white offset shadow, so nothing marks the hover.
Single-column stack of outlined cards under a collapsed teal band with a horizontally scrolling pill strip. The spec turns the lift off on touch (hover:hover guard), so a flat card here is correct.

Product detail with teal band, breadcrumb and title. Below the pink 'Add to cart' button, a raised confirmation card with an ink border, a hard offset shadow, a pink check icon and an underlined 'View cart' link says what was added. The cart count in the header shows 1.
The same layout in dark mode. The confirmation card is raised #222 with a light border and the light offset shadow, its text reads clearly, and the pink submit is still the only pink action.

Stacked detail page: band title, image well, price, outlined colour choice pill and quantity stepper. The shadowed confirmation card with the check and 'View cart' link sits right under the submit, inside the reading flow.

Yellow cart band, then outlined Items and Checkout cards. A subtle-well summary ('Fix 3 fields below…') with an icon tops the form, each field has a red border plus an icon and message, and the focused field shows the pink halo with the ink ring.

Dark version: the error summary is a dark well, field borders are dark red with icons and messages that stay readable, and the first field carries the pink halo. The pink 'Place order' button is the only pink action.
One-column cart then checkout card. The error summary, red-bordered fields with an icon and message under each, and the pink-halo focus on Full name all fit at 390px with nothing clipped.
Focus sits on the 'Cart' nav pill, which shows a 2px ink outline ring at an offset next to the ink-filled current 'Shop' pill. It is clearly visible against the white header.
In dark mode the focused 'Cart' pill gets a pink 2px ring at an offset, and the current 'Shop' pill is paper-filled. The ring stands out clearly on the dark header.
Mobile header with the 'Cart' pill showing the ink focus outline beside the ink-filled 'Shop' pill. The band and pill strip below it are unchanged and readable.

All 11 drawings are the same generic picture-frame icon in ink on a band-colour square. They follow the 'band colour with an ink glyph' placeholder rule but say nothing about each item, and the grid is one repeated icon.
A large yellow well with the same generic picture icon scaled up. Clean and tokenized, but it reads as 'missing image' rather than an object drawn from basic shapes.
A yellow-green well with the same generic picture icon. It is identical in kind to every other product placeholder, so nothing tells this product apart.

Empty-cart sticker: a tilted pink coin face over an offset yellow rim with a heavy ink outline and a bold ink plus glyph. Flat with no gradient, it reads clearly as a sticker coin at its size and follows the coin recipe.

findings.summary: In the card-hover state no product card is lifted: no -4px translate and no hard offset shadow, so hover is indistinguishable from rest in both themes.
findings.promptFix: Apply the lift to the element that actually receives the pointer: when a whole card is a link, put the .lift translate and shadow.md on the card's outer bordered box (the anchor or the card wrapping it), keep 8px of clearance so no ancestor's overflow clips it, and check by hovering a card that it moves and shows the offset shadow.

findings.summary: Every product image placeholder is the same generic picture-frame icon, so the grid and detail pages repeat one 'missing image' glyph instead of flat sticker objects that tell items apart.
